create.name: T. Susan Chang
create.bio:
T. Susan Chang, known to students as Susie, is a tarot reader, teacher and author living in western Massachusetts. She bought her first deck in New York in the mid-1990s, read weekly at a café in Hell's Kitchen, took classes at the Tarot School and was certified as a professional reader in 1999. After years of reading casually she came back to the cards seriously in 2015, and she now reads every week at a crystal shop in Northampton as well as online.

Her books focus on the esoteric structure behind the cards: Tarot Correspondences maps elemental, astrological, numerical and Kabbalistic associations; 36 Secrets follows the decans through the minor arcana; Tarot Deciphered, written with Mel Meleen, decodes the symbolism of modern esoteric decks; The Living Tarot is her guide to teaching yourself to read; and 4 Stories takes an elemental approach to the deck. With Mel Meleen she hosts the weekly Fortune's Wheelhouse podcast, which works through tarot symbolism card by card. She teaches the self-paced Living Tarot online course and offers one-to-one readings and private lessons by Zoom, with in-person sessions in Amherst, Montague or Northampton on request. She also designed the Arcana Case for tarot decks.

books.title: Tarot Correspondences
books.author: T. Susan Chang
books.description: A reference to the four systems built into most modern decks, the elements, astrology, number and Kabbalah, with tables for every card and exercises for using them in readings and ritual.

books.title: 36 Secrets
books.author: T. Susan Chang
books.description: A journey through the 36 decans of the zodiac as they appear in the numbered minor arcana, card by card.

books.title: Tarot Deciphered
books.author: T. Susan Chang and M. M. Meleen
books.description: Written with Mel Meleen, a detailed key to the esoteric symbols in the Rider-Waite-Smith and Thoth traditions.

books.title: The Living Tarot
books.author: T. Susan Chang
books.description: Her method for teaching yourself to read by linking each card to scenes from everyday life, so meanings are discovered rather than memorised.

books.title: 4 Stories
books.author: T. Susan Chang
books.description: Her 2025 book on the four classical elements and how Fire, Water, Air and Earth shape the tarot.

courses.title: The Living Tarot Online Course
courses.description: A self-paced course run on Google Classroom for new and experienced readers, using a Rider-Waite-Smith style deck and practical exercises to build fluent reading. Payment plans are available.

courses.title: Tarot Readings and Private Lessons
courses.description: One-to-one tarot counselling and private tarot lessons by Zoom, with in-person sessions in Amherst, Montague or Northampton on request. A short intake form helps focus the question.

free_resources.title: Fortune's Wheelhouse podcast
free_resources.description: A free weekly esoteric tarot podcast she co-hosts with Mel Meleen, unpacking the symbolism and lore of the cards.
